subject.title: Plugin installs crash Express 4.x routes: core npm-shrinkwrap pins path-to-regexp@8.x but no central override covers plugins

question: Should managed npm plugin roots inherit OpenClaw host pnpm overrides unchanged, filter/scoped-propagate overrides such as `path-to-regexp`, or only validate and error for known plugin dependency conflicts?
rationale: The right fix changes the dependency ownership boundary for third-party plugin installs and the security override policy, so automation should not choose it without maintainer intent.

options.title: Scope managed-root overrides
options.body: Preserve security-critical host override propagation where needed while excluding or namespacing overrides that conflict with plugin-owned runtime dependency graphs.

options.title: Validator-only diagnostic
options.body: Detect Express 4 plus incompatible `path-to-regexp` during install/update and fail with a clear remediation message, leaving package authors responsible for overrides or shrinkwrap.

options.title: Keep plugin-owned workaround
options.body: Document that Express 4 plugin packages must ship their own override or shrinkwrap and leave managed roots inheriting host overrides unchanged.

recommendation.title: Scope managed-root overrides
recommendation.body: Preserve security-critical host override propagation where needed while excluding or namespacing overrides that conflict with plugin-owned runtime dependency graphs.

likelyOwner.reason: This login is the strongest current-history owner for managed npm root override propagation and plugin dependency docs.
